sourceOpening: Captured Konfetti candle opener, still locked before user interaction; the candle flame and source decorations are visible.
captureMethod: Packaged Konfetti source rendered over local HTTP in headless Edge at a 450x800 CSS-pixel viewport and DPR 1. The uz-Latn birthday fixture name and greeting were passed through window.name and the packaged platform bridge. qaReducedMotion=1 holds the candle flame in its source-rendered static state. A capture-only same-origin parent style hides the shared runtime's injected .mh-lang control; no template or runtime source was changed. After document.fonts.ready and a 5000ms headless capture timeout, the locked opener was saved as preview-capture.png and encoded to WebP with Pillow at quality 94, method 6.
